blocks.text: AI isn't just for school – you can also have fun and be creative with it!
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.
Write a short, funny story about a cat who wants to become an astronaut. Max 10 sentences, for 11-year-olds.
Give me 3 riddles about animals, and write the answers at the end.
Make me a 5-question quiz about football, one question at a time. Wait for my answer before the next question.
You're the author! Ask the AI for ideas, then change them your way – that makes the story really yours.
You can ask: "You're a space guide and I'm an astronaut. Take me through the Solar System." The AI will play the role and teach you along the way.
